items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So he organised a jazz group called, 'Mouse and his Music'. That was my very, very first band that I played in

ctx.x: Well, in those days, oh of course you'd heard Louis Armstrong's records by this time?

Yes, But I, oh yes, I mustn't forget this. There was a fellow who came back to Parsons from Kansas City, his name was Raymond Jones, and he had played at the Eblon Theater in Kansas City in which Basie....
